turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². Return the TOTAL area (km², 1 dp) of the Voronoi cells belonging to the three roadside stations (station_id 14, 16, 17).
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
WITH stations AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_Extent(geom)::geometry, 4326) AS geom
    FROM stations
),
vor_cells AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom), 0, (SELECT geom FROM bbox)))).geom AS geom
    FROM stations
),
assigned AS (
    SELECT s.id, ST_Intersection(v.geom, b.geom) AS clipped_geom
    FROM vor_cells v
    CROSS JOIN bbox b
    JOIN stations s ON ST_Covers(v.geom, s.geom)
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS assigned_cell_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN id IN (14,16,17) THEN ST_Area(clipped_geom::geography) / 1000000.0 ELSE 0 END) AS roadside_area_km2
FROM assigned;
""")
res = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
roadside_cells_km2 = float(round(res.loc[0, "roadside_area_km2"], 1))
print({"assigned_cell_count": int(res.loc[0, "assigned_cell_count"]), "roadside_cells_km2": roadside_cells_km2})
